# The classic protocol's CRC-16 (poly 0x1021, init 0xffff, msb first) and move checksum (over
# the key table, classic_checksum_table.cpp), held by tests/shooters_edge_classic_wire_test.cpp.
#   crc16 <bytes hex or -> <crc hex>
#   chk <sequence, decimal> <move body hex or -> <checksum byte hex>
#   sweep <move body hex> <first sequence> <last sequence> <FNV-1a 32 over the checksum bytes>
